plan: Full design document delivered covering: (0) single CONFIG slot enumerating every fixed-by-design parameter; (1) rationale explaining why distributional similarity at the (phi, psi, chi, top-TICA) level is the right question on tetrapeptides; (2) system + locked sequence panel (20 AA termini + chi-rich subset {Arg,Lys,Leu,Ile,Phe,Tyr,Trp,Met,Glu,Gln,His}, n>=10, default 13 listed); (3) CV computation including torsion definitions, locked TICA top-k rule (spectral-gap on MD only, hard cap k<=4, >=60% cumulative variance floor, fallback to smallest satisfying k), locked lag selection by VAMP-2 with 2x/0.5x neighboring lags as appendix sensitivity, locked k-means elbow over k=2..6 with min-3-stability-across-seed criterion; (4) full per-CV-family metric tables; (5) four controls/baselines (self-MD noise floor, held-out MD cross-sequence variability, degraded-model ablation with feature-shuffle native control); (6) analysis pipeline with 8-block bootstrap, B=1000, ESS via autocorrelation truncation per torsion PC per trajectory reported per-peptide and pooled; (7) feasibility in design terms (MDTraj, PyEMMA, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn; per-peptide minutes on CPU; panel-scale low-single-digit hours on a 24-CPU node; no GPU); (8) per-metric decision table mapping each metric to its self-MD, degraded-baseline, a1/a2/a3 conditions and pass criterion; (9) nine stated assumptions A1-A9 and ten explicit invalidation conditions I1-I10 mapping each break in design coherence back to the affected verdict. All locked decisions from the prior turn are encoded exactly as approved (CONFIG slot, sequence-panel tiers, TICA top-k rule, 8 blocks, B=1000, 60% floor, k<=4, lag by VAMP-2, scrambled-feature baseline, 72x72 grid, FD-with-50-bin-cap, k-means with min-3-seed ARI>=0.8, majority rule across CV families strong/weak/no, ESS>=50).

context.question: Do the sampled trajectories from the forward simulation model exhibit distributional similarity to ground-truth MD trajectories across key collective variables, such as backbone torsions, sidechain torsions, and top TICA components?
context.context: Design an experiment that answers the question. The researcher can clarify source-supported setup details by topic. Do not claim that an experiment was run.
